review_candidates.description: Head of Insights Practice (Finance and Banking) with experience from CX research Location: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam Practice: Finance and Banking Reporting to: CEO Working model: Semi-hybrid Eligibility: This is a local position on local terms, open to both Vietnamese nationals and expats already based in Vietnam. ABOUT DECISION LAB Decision Lab is an insights-driven consulting firm helping organisations in Southeast Asia turn opportunity into intentional, innovation-led growth by making better commercial decisions in fast-changing markets. We attract some of the most ambitious people in our industry, and we have built the firm around them: a place for ambitious, curious minds to do work that changes what clients decide, and to go further here than they would elsewhere. ABOUT THE ROLE You will lead Decision Lab's Finance & Banking practice and own its P&L. The practice works with leading banks, insurers, consumer-finance businesses and fintechs across Vietnam and the region. Our thesis is straightforward: the race for new customers is largely over, and the next decade of banking growth comes from relationship value, meaning primary status, daily usage, and the affluent and mass-affluent segments that carry the economics. That shift changes the decisions on a bank CEO's desk, and those are the decisions we work on. Our work spans primary-relationship and CASA driver studies, brand health tied to commercial outcomes, affluent and wealth proposition testing, and customer experience measurement. We publish an annual Bank Customer Satisfaction Rankings, an independent external benchmark banks cannot generate from their own dashboards, alongside syndicated research on the financial decision journey. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE IS ONE OF OUR GROWTH PILLARS, AND IT IS WHERE WE WANT THIS HIRE TO ADD CAPABILITY Digital transformation is now table stakes in Vietnamese banking, and satisfaction has become the competitive battleground. Our own rankings put the top four banks within five points of each other. Clients are moving from tracking satisfaction to diagnosing journeys and acting on drivers. We have the foundations: an established satisfaction benchmark, a partnership with Alchemer, and working relationships with several specialist CX platform vendors. What we want is someone who deepens that competency inside the team, bringing methodological confidence across the full arc of a CX programme, and building it into how the practice sells and delivers. WHAT YOU WILL OWN • The Finance & Banking practice P&L: revenue, margin, growth • Sector strategy and the commercial direction of the practice • Senior client relationships across banking, insurance, consumer finance and fintech, as the trusted adviser clients call first • New business: pipeline, proposals and pricing • Deepening Decision Lab's CX capability and converting it into client work • Growing paid engagements from our satisfaction rankings and syndicated finance intelligence • Quality and commercial oversight of the practice's major engagements • Building the practice's leadership bench, developing project leaders rather than only managing analysts • Method and innovation in the sector: new approaches, AI-enabled research, and better answers reached faster • Decision Lab's authority in the sector through thought leadership and industry visibility WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • A strong financial-services background, built inside a bank, insurer or consumer-finance business, or advising them from an insights, strategy or consulting firm • 8+ years of relevant experience, including 2 to 3 years at a leading market research firm. Agency-side experience is essential: it is where commercial leadership, proposal ownership and P&L discipline are built • Functional depth in insights, strategy or customer experience, and the judgement to know which of the three a client problem actually needs • Hands-on experience with customer experience research: designing it, running it, and turning the results into decisions clients act on • Evidence you can convert credibility into commercial results: proposals won, relationships grown, revenue built • Comfort owning a P&L and being measured on it • The instinct to build a practice strategy rather than execute someone else's WHAT YOU WILL GET • P&L ownership of an established practice with a strong client base and an independent public benchmark behind it • Direct access to senior decision-makers across Vietnam's financial-services sector • Autonomy to shape the practice's commercial direction • A total target salary built from monthly salary, bonus at target, and a monthly employer contribution to a long-term savings account in your name, run with Dragon Capital • A performance bonus weighted towards the commercial results you own, paid quarterly • 17 days' annual leave, rising with tenure, plus recharge days and a protected recovery day after any project that took your weekend • Private health insurance • A personal learning budget, AI tooling and leadership training • One day a week working from home, and pre-approved days working from your hometown • A collaborative workspace at The Sentry, Ho Chi Minh City

review_candidates.description: About The Company Ambis Resourcing is a reputable organization specializing in providing tailored ERP solutions and consultancy services to a diverse range of clients. Known for its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, Ambis Resourcing has built a strong reputation for delivering innovative and reliable software solutions that enhance business operations. The company values its employees and fosters a collaborative and supportive work environment, which has resulted in an impressive track record of low staff turnover and long-term client partnerships. With a focus on continuous improvement and technological excellence, Ambis Resourcing remains at the forefront of ERP development and implementation, serving clients across various industries including manufacturing, logistics, and finance. About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled ERP Developer to join our team on a home-based basis, offering a competitive salary of up to £60,000. This role involves working closely with clients to develop bespoke functionalities for their ERP systems using Java, JavaScript, and SQL. The primary responsibility is to translate client requirements into technical specifications and develop tailored solutions that address their unique business processes. You will act as a bridge between the client and the technical team, ensuring that the delivered solutions meet the specified needs and are aligned with best practices. The role offers flexibility in scheduling client visits, which are typically once or twice a month, and requires attendance at bi-monthly team meetings near Nottingham. This position is ideal for a developer with a strong background in ERP-related functionalities and a passion for problem-solving and client engagement. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a solid development background with recent hands-on experience in Java, JavaScript, and SQL. A strong understanding of ERP modules such as warehousing, stock management, order processing, financial reporting, manufacturing, MRP, and production is essential. You should demonstrate excellent communication skills, with the ability to gather and interpret client requirements accurately, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience will also be considered. The ability to work independently and manage your own schedule is crucial for success in this role. Responsibilities Your key responsibilities will include developing custom ERP functionalities based on client specifications, creating detailed requirement documents, and providing conceptual overviews of proposed solutions. You will collaborate with clients to refine their requirements through iterative discussions and ensure that the technical implementation aligns with their business needs. You will be responsible for designing, coding, testing, and deploying bespoke features, ensuring high-quality standards and adherence to project timelines. Occasional client visits will be arranged by you, and you will maintain ongoing communication to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments. Additionally, you will participate in bi-monthly team meetings, sharing insights and learning from colleagues. Supporting the technical team and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the company will also be part of your role. Benefits Joining Ambis Resourcing offers numerous benefits, including the opportunity to work remotely with flexible scheduling, allowing you to manage your workload effectively. The role provides a competitive salary of up to £60,000, along with potential career development opportunities within a growing organization. You will be part of a highly skilled and supportive team of 12 consultants and a development team of 20, fostering an environment of learning and professional growth. The company’s strong client relationships and low staff turnover mean you will work on long-term projects with loyal clients who value quality and innovation. Additional benefits include participation in regular team meetings, ongoing training and development programs, and the chance to work on diverse and challenging projects that will enhance your skills and expertise. Equal Opportunity Ambis Resourcing is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply and join our vibrant and dynamic team.
